items.q: And that was made in February of 1975 with ... Jimmy Garrison, and Beaver Harris on drums.

ctx.x: So, we do have copies of that album.
And that was made in February of 1975 with Herb Hall on clarinet, Doc Cheatham on trumpet, Marshall Brown on valve trombone, Dave Gurrell on piano, Jimmy Garrison, and Beaver Harris on drums.
